summary: A cartoon world of smiling characters for a rounded family inspired by Japanese signage. A sleepy sun wakes up as you scroll through the intro, then colour-coded chapters (Story, Design, Typeface, Mono, Mega, Emoji, Overview) each bring Lottie characters, sticky speech-bubble text and an inline tester card that opens a full food-themed tester. A progress-bar nav fills with each chapter's colour.

instances.look: Electric-blue sky, 'GT MARU' top-left in yellow with a black offset outline, a big pink round sun face with red cheeks on the right, white outlined clouds, and an orange 'SCROLL' between two down arrows at the bottom; a thin white progress-bar nav with 'Try' and 'Buy' pills at the top
instances.ux: While the page loads, the sun sleeps (yawns, 'zz') and the nav tabs fill like a loading bar; once loaded it wakes and smiles. Scrolling snaps through steps in which clouds drift past and the sun reacts (surprised, curious) to the intro text
instances.learn: Use the loader as part of the hero story (the mascot sleeps while loading and wakes up when ready), so waiting feels like the opening scene

reconstruction.layout: Pinned 1440×900 stage inside a 5400px intro (3 scroll-snap steps); title at x=20,y=60; sun ~240px circle at x≈780,y≈260; SCROLL hint centred at y≈690 with arrows at the left and right edges; clouds absolutely positioned and layered
reconstruction.typography: Title 187px GT Maru (wght 550), uppercase, yellow with a duplicated black outline offset as a drop shadow (data-outline-duplicate-text); SCROLL ~30px, letters in different colours; nav pills ~25px
reconstruction.behaviour: lottie-player maru-intro.json scrubbed by scroll position across .scrollsnap steps (sleep → wake → surprise); 20 cloud SVGs move at different speeds; text boxes toggle .textbox-intro-hidden per step; nav #progress-bar width = scroll % and colour = current section's data-nav-color
reconstruction.assets: Lottie of the sun face, 10 cloud SVGs

instances.look: Two yellow rounded speech-bubble boxes appearing one per scroll step beside the sun: 'We're proud to present GT Maru, an ode to rounded English characters found on signage across Japan…' and 'The typeface is a result of Thierry Blancpain's trips to Japan…'
instances.feel: Like the mascot is being told the story
instances.ux: Each scroll-snap step reveals the next bubble while the sun's expression changes
instances.learn: Split the intro into two short bubbles tied to scroll steps, and give the mascot a reaction to each: the text gets read because something responds to it
